headword: {注目|ちゅうもく}を{浴|あ}びる
gloss: to attract attention; to be in the spotlight

definitions.gloss: to attract attention; to be in the spotlight; to draw notice
definitions.explanation: To become the focus of public attention or interest. Literally means to bathe in attention. Used for people, events, products, or topics that are drawing widespread notice.

examples.japanese: {世界中|せかいじゅう}から{注目|ちゅうもく}を{浴|あ}びている。
examples.english: It is attracting attention from around the world.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}のスピーチは{大|おお}きな{注目|ちゅうもく}を{浴|あ}びた。
examples.english: Her speech attracted a great deal of attention.

examples.japanese: この{技術|ぎじゅつ}は{環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}の{解決策|かいけつさく}として{注目|ちゅうもく}を{浴|あ}びている。
examples.english: This technology is drawing attention as a solution to environmental problems.

notes:
Composed of {注目|ちゅうもく} (attention, notice) + を + {浴|あ}びる (to bathe in, to be showered with). The verb {浴|あ}びる conveys being drenched or showered in something, creating a vivid image of being surrounded by attention.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|おお}きな{注目|ちゅうもく}を{浴|あ}びる (to attract great attention)
- {世界的|せかいてき}に{注目|ちゅうもく}を{浴|あ}びる (to attract worldwide attention)
- {再|ふたた}び{注目|ちゅうもく}を{浴|あ}びる (to attract attention again)
- メディアの{注目|ちゅうもく}を{浴|あ}びる (to attract media attention)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {注目|ちゅうもく}を{集|あつ}める — to gather attention; very similar, slightly less vivid
- {注目|ちゅうもく}される — to be noted; more neutral and formal
- {脚光|きゃっこう}を{浴|あ}びる — to be in the limelight; more dramatic, used for performers and public figures

USAGE:
{注目|ちゅうもく}を{浴|あ}びる is extremely common in news and media. It is more vivid and expressive than the neutral {注目|ちゅうもく}される, suggesting a flood of attention rather than merely being noticed.
